subject: Booth and seating repair
body:

name: Cyber Fleet USA
subject: Seat and interior repair for your Cybercab fleet
body:
Hi Jeff,

I'm Dillon with Lerega, an upholstery and leather repair shop in Lakeway. I read about your plans for a Cybercab fleet in Greater Austin.

Robotaxi seats get heavy use, and cuts, stains, burns and worn spots are usually much cheaper to repair than to replace. We repair seats and interior trim in cars, RVs and boats, have fleet pricing, and offer pickup and delivery.

When your first cars are on the road, would you be open to a quick call?

name: Safely
subject: Furniture repair for rental damage claims
body:
Hi Safely team,

I'm Dillon with Lerega, an upholstery and leather furniture repair shop in Lakeway. When a guest damages a sofa, chair or headboard in a short-term rental, we can usually repair it for much less than a replacement: tears, stains, pet damage, cracked or faded leather. Hosts get a written estimate from photos that they can attach to a claim, and we work on site or pick the piece up anywhere around Austin and San Antonio.

If you work with repair vendors on claims in Central Texas, or can point hosts to one, we'd be glad to help. Could you pass this to Gabriel Urrea or Amber Harris on your claims team?

Dillon
